steps.message: In Simple Calendar Pro, create a recurring calendar event titled 'Review session for Project X' starting on 2023-10-25 at 4h. The event recurs weekly, forever, and lasts for 60 minutes each occurrence. The event description should be 'We will finalize business objectives.'.

Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -i -E 'simple|calendar'; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/calendars --projection _id:calendar_displayName:account_name:account_type:visible:sync_events"
